_about: Public-domain John McNeill (1854-1933), Scottish Presbyterian evangelist and minister of Regent Square, London, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons (1890), Regent Square Pulpit (1891), and The Twenty-Third Psalm (1927). He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 117 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jmcneill-regent-square: Regent Square pulpit: sermons (James Nisbet & Co., 1891, 1891)
jmcneill-23rd-psalm: The twenty-third Psalm (New York, Chicago Fleming H. Revell Company, 1927)
